description:
## Why

After PKIX-amgn.3 lands `pkix-lint-cabf`, the original `pkix-lint` crate keeps only:

1. `Lint` trait, `LintRunner`, `Finding`, `EvaluationReport`, `DeviationStore`, `DeviatedFinding` (framework).
2. RFC-conformance lints (RFC 5280 §4.2.1.* violations, RFC 6960 OCSP response anomalies, RFC 4518 DN-encoding issues, etc.).

CA/B Forum-specific lint bundles move to `pkix-lint-cabf`. Breaking change for downstream consumers using `cabf.br.tls` rule bundle directly.

## What

### Stays in pkix-lint

- Framework types listed above.
- Standards-body lints: anything keyed off RFC / ITU-T / NIST text.

Suggested initial standards-body lint set (curate from what's already there):

- `rfc5280.crit-ext-must-be-recognized` (RFC 5280 §6.1 critical-extension handling)
- `rfc5280.basic-constraints-on-ca` (§4.2.1.9)
- `rfc5280.keyusage-keycertsign-on-ca` (§4.2.1.3)
- `rfc5280.serial-number-positive` (§4.1.2.2 — non-zero, ≤ 20 octets, positive)
- `rfc5280.validity-encoding` (§4.1.2.5 — UTCTime vs GeneralizedTime boundary)
- `rfc4518.dn-string-prep` (advisory: warns when DN encodings won't normalize cleanly)
- `rfc6960.ocsp-producedAt-vs-thisUpdate` (advisory: sanity check)
- (More as the existing lint corpus is triaged.)

### Moves to pkix-lint-cabf

- Anything keyed off a CA/B Forum ballot (SC-081, SC-072, etc.).
- `cabf.br.tls` / `cabf.br.smime` rule bundle identifiers.
- Bundle-version constants pinned to BR revision numbers.

### Existing test fixtures

`EvaluationReport::new("cabf.br.tls", "SC-081", "v0.2.0", ...)` examples in rustdoc and tests — replace the bundle-name string with a generic example like `"rfc5280.core"` or `"example.lint-bundle"` for the framework crate's docs. CA/B Forum-specific examples move to `pkix-lint-cabf` rustdoc.

## Acceptance

- [ ] No `cabf.*` rule identifiers in pkix-lint source.
- [ ] At least 4-6 RFC-conformance lints retained or extracted as the canonical 'standards-body lint bundle.'
- [ ] cargo check + tests clean across workspace.
- [ ] Crate version bumped (breaking change).
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry documenting the migration.

## Depends on

PKIX-amgn.1, PKIX-amgn.3 (target crate for moved content).
notes:
OSCAL alignment retrofit (2026-05-11, per PKIX-ztmr stance): the refactored pkix-lint MUST ship the OSCAL-shaped types from PKIX-9vnx (EvaluationReport → Assessment Results, Finding → Finding + Observation, Deviation → Risk, Lint → Control). NOT bespoke-then-realign-later. The RFC-conformance lint bundle becomes the project's reference OSCAL Catalog (per PKIX-9vnx.6). This bead now depends on PKIX-9vnx.6 (Lint-as-Control mapping). Without that prerequisite, the refactor would deliver bespoke types that need to be re-broken later — bad sequencing.
Scope reshape 2026-05-11: this bead's substantive content is now reframed under the zlint-derived OSCAL Catalog approach (PKIX-amgn.8).

Original framing: 'author cabf.br.tls / cabf.br.smime lint bundles by hand-reading the CA/B Forum BR PDFs and translating each rule.'

Reframed under PKIX-amgn.8: vendor zlint's catalog as OSCAL Catalog JSON; pkix-lint-cabf interprets it at runtime; this bead implements the Rust check_cert() bodies referencing the catalog's Control IDs.

This bead's acceptance criteria stand: pkix-lint keeps RFC-conformance lints; CA/B Forum content lives in pkix-lint-cabf. The HOW changed; the WHAT didn't.
title: Refactor pkix-lint: strip CA/B Forum lint bundles, keep framework + RFC-conformance lints
